newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly lower, drugs firm Pliva up.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly lower, drugs firm Pliva up.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mostly lower on Wednesday in a somewhat brisker trade, with drugs firm Pliva rebounding.
* Of seven active issues, two rose, four fell and one was flat.
* Volume was higher at 1,470 shares, turnover also rose to 1.3 million kuna. For full details see page ZAGSTOCK.
* Top gainer Pliva jumped 400 kuna to 13,000 with 54 shares changing hands.
* Top decliner hotelier Laguna fell 100 kuna to 1,050, on volume of 39 shares.
* Most active confectioner Kras lost 60 kuna to close at 450, trading 629 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
